title: 출국대기실 운영 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00009:part:1/1
full_text: Article 9 (Application Mutatis Mutandis of Rules on Protection of Foreigners) Except as otherwise provided in these Rules, Articles 8, 9, 14 through 16, 18, 19, 21, Article 22 (1) and (2), Articles 28, 32, 42, 43, Articles 43-2 through 43-6, and Article 49 of the Rules on Protection of Foreigners shall apply mutatis mutandis to operation of departure waiting rooms. In such cases, "protected foreigner" shall be deemed "admitted foreigner," "protection facility" shall be deemed "departure waiting room," and "protection period" shall be deemed "period of admission"; in Article 9 (5), "Article 56-3 (3) of the Act" shall be deemed "Article 3 (3)"; in Article 32 (1), "Articles 56-2 through 56-9 and Article 57 of the Act" shall be deemed "Articles 76-2 through 76-4 of the Immigration Act"; in Article 42 and the main sentence of Article 43-3 (1) 1 (a) and subparagraph 2 of the same paragraph, "Article 56-4 (1) of the Act" shall be deemed "Article 76-4 (1) of the Act"; and in the provisos to Article 43-3 (1) 1 (a) and subparagraph 2 of the same paragraph, "Article 56-4 (1) 4 of the Act" shall be deemed "Article 76-4 (1) 3 of the Act." <Amended on December 5, 2022>
